# Completed Plans

This directory is the plan log — the historical record of
finished work. Every plan here has Status `Completed` or
`Canceled`.

**These plans are frozen.** Do not edit, append to,
rename, move, or delete them — they record what was
decided and delivered at the time, and commits reference
them by filename through their `Plan:` trailer. Read them
for history and context only.

If a finished plan needs follow-up — missed scope, a
regression, a change of direction — write a new plan in
the plans directory rather than reopening this one, and
name this one as related prior work in its Context.
